# fwup v1.1.0 - Table of Contents

> Simple Elixir wrapper around FWUP.

## Modules

- [Fwup](https://fwup.hexdocs.pm/Fwup.md): Configurable embedded Linux firmware update creator and runner

- [Fwup.Command](https://fwup.hexdocs.pm/Fwup.Command.md): Execute one off fwup commands

- [Fwup.Metadata](https://fwup.hexdocs.pm/Fwup.Metadata.md): Fwup Metadata

- [Fwup.Stream](https://fwup.hexdocs.pm/Fwup.Stream.md): Process wrapper around the `fwup` port.
Should be used with `--framing`
